ev.q: Thunderbirds Are Go is an animated science fiction television programme
Set in the 2060s, Thunderbirds Are Go follows the exploits of the Tracy brothers
technologically advanced craft for land, sea, air and space rescues
a British criminal mastermind who despises the organisation
the loss of Jeff to his sons plays a key element
In addition to the brothers, IR also includes additional members who offer assistance and support
running for 78 episodes across three series
premiered on 4 April 2015 and concluded on 22 February 2020
